{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693503843,"sessionID":"ses_e23f0c232ffeD6P4suA8DYQAvC","part":{"id":"prt_1dc119a73001eitTqVaxZSSbK4","messageID":"msg_1dc1178f8001irWSH23UrPjTQF","sessionID":"ses_e23f0c232ffeD6P4suA8DYQAvC","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. From minute 85 to minute 120 all four customer-facing services showed 0% errors, with no throttles on and no extra replicas.\n\nI found and fixed four causes:\n\n1. **payouts-svc deploy v67** (rolled back at minute 11): it cut the call deadline 10x, from `budget_ms / 1000` to `budget_ms / 10000`. Its failures flowed up to bundles-svc and mobile-api.\n2. **feeds-svc deploy v136** (rolled back at minute 46): it dropped the `orders.write` permission. limits-svc calls to feeds-svc failed, which gave admin-portal 4% errors. admin-portal earns $12.4k/min, so this was the most expensive fault.\n   - **Mistake on my part:** the rollback pushed feeds-svc into a retry storm. admin-portal errors went up to 55% and then about 70% (partly from my throttle) for roughly 8 minutes. A 70% throttle on feeds-svc for two minutes broke the storm, and admin-portal was at 0% by minute 55.\n3. **bundles-svc config cfg-50** (reverted at minute 67): it cut `rate_limit_per_s` from 5000 to 50, which left bundles-svc stuck in a retry storm with mobile-api failing 85–95%. My first throttle at minute 49 couldn't fix it because the bad limit was still live. After the revert, a second short throttle broke the storm.\n4. **labels-svc config cfg-4** (reverted at minute 80): this started during the shift, at minute 58. It set `entry_ttl_s` from 600 to 1 and caused a retry storm. Through other services, it took mobile-api and web-storefront errors up to about 23%. I reverted it and throttled labels-svc for about two minutes.\n\n**Not fixed:** suggest-svc ran at about 98% CPU throughout, but its logs show the cause was the scheduled `nightly-rollup` job and it hardly failed any requests. I didn't change it, so no wasted-mitigation charge applied there.\n\n**Biggest losses:**\n- **admin-portal:** about 4% errors until minute 46, plus the 8-minute spike after the feeds-svc rollback.\n- **mobile-api:** mostly failing until bundles-svc recovered after minute 67, and hit again by labels-svc until minute 84.\n\nI don't have the final score.","time":{"start":1794693503603,"end":1794693503840}}}
